_comment: Task 1.7: systems of orrery. Offsets in light-years from the region center (D12). Planets come in tasks 1.8 and 1.9.

systems.name: The Orrery
systems.notes: Nine worlds circle a single Absent structure. A red dwarf several light-hours away lights them faintly.

bodies.name: Central structure
bodies.class: dark Absent object the size of a small moon
bodies.notes: A single Absent structure, dark and about the size of a small moon, with no star at the center. It warms the nine worlds that circle it in exact resonance and is veined through with lattice.

bodies.name: Lamp (WIP)
bodies.notes: Red dwarf several light-hours from the central structure. It lights the nine worlds faintly; the structure warms them.
